create_event_with_action: create an Event from a callable function using Event.from_function to schedule it in the simulation
create_condition_check_event: create a ConditionCheckEvent from a boolean condition function that checks the environment state periodically
create_validation_event: create a ValidationEvent with milestone and minefield callbacks to validate environment state over time
register_event_decorator: register an App method as an event using the event_registered decorator to log completed events
create_event_log: create an EventLog to store and retrieve CompletedEvent instances from past simulation events
